brief.objective: A one-day creative AI hackathon from 36 Labs and fal at Ramen Space in Dalston, London. Teams build systems that turn briefs into finished videos and compete for $4,000 in prizes.

creativeThesis: One anonymous maker's desk from first light to night: a blank storyboard card pinned at dawn becomes a finished render by dark.

intent.product: No Slop Allowed: a one-day creative AI hackathon by 36 Labs and fal at Ramen Space, Dalston, London
intent.audience: London creative technologists and AI video builders
intent.message: Spend one day building a system that turns briefs into finished videos, with $4,000 in prizes.

realWorldGrounding: brief fact: one-day hackathon, teams build systems that turn briefs into finished videos
brief fact: 36 Labs and fal at Ramen Space, Dalston, London
physical anchors: cork wall of pencil storyboard cards, laptop with a video timeline, real window light changing through the day

selectedGoal.title: A Day of Building
selectedGoal.description: Documentary-style observation of a single desk across one day of the hackathon: pinning storyboard cards in morning light, working the laptop in the afternoon, a render finishing at night. It sells the event as real, hand-made building rather than slop.
selectedGoal.style: Observational documentary, 35mm lens feel, natural window light shifting through the day, linen white, sage green wall, dusk violet night window, warm desk lamp, soft film grain

decisionEvidence.selectedReason: Directly dramatises the brief (one day building a brief-to-video system) with concrete desk/storyboard/render anchors and model-friendly simple actions.

referencesUsed.title: How I Create Viral AI Construction Time-Lapse Videos From Scratch
referencesUsed.why: Time-lapse progression formats (empty to finished across one locked frame) are a widely copied AI-video format; transferable: one fixed space shown at successive times of day, each cut a visible step of progress. Metrics unverified (search result only).

referencesUsed.title: SNOW BEAR - A Hand-Drawn Animated Short Film by Aaron Blaise
referencesUsed.why: Hand-made craft framing: warm, human, tactile process (pencil, paper, desk) signals care and authorship, the opposite of slop. Transferable: hands at a desk, paper drawings, warm lamp light. Metrics unverified.

creative.reason: Clear dawn-to-night day-of-building arc on one desk, warm natural palette, no faces, captions legible and factual. Hook is soft (hand reaching to a card rather than a hard pin press).
creative.biggestProblem: Opening action is gentle rather than punchy.

slopHits.note: pin press reads as gentle touch
